description: Per-child annual school lunch values the Census Bureau assigned in the public-use CPS ASEC, by reference year. Aggregate modes only; no record-level data.

2018.method: Two most common positive values of SPM_SCHLUNCH summed over the household's SPM units divided by HFLUNNO, among HFLUNCH == 1 households whose HFLUNNO equals the count of members aged 5-18

2019.method: Two most common positive values of SPM_SCHLUNCH summed over the household's SPM units divided by HFLUNNO, among HFLUNCH == 1 households whose HFLUNNO equals the count of members aged 5-18
